results: Requirement F18 fully implemented: Subject/action/context/revision all bind cache; revoke invalidates stale decisions.
Bounded DecisionCache implemented in internal/policy/cache.go with deterministic O(1) LRU eviction and strict <=30s TTL bound enforcement (satisfying F09/F18).

Four-dimensional deterministic cache key computation implemented with SHA-256 formatting pk:<64-hex>, binding Subject (ID, Issuer, sorted Roles, Authenticated, SessionEpoch, SessionID), Action (normalized lowercase), Context (Path, ResourceID, OwnerScope), and Revision (Revision, PolicyDigest).

Revocation invalidation verified: explicit InvalidateSession, InvalidateSubject, and InvalidateScope immediately evict stale cached decisions; live RevocationChecker drops revoked sessions and outdated epochs on cache retrieval.
Zero-token invariant strictly enforced: CacheKeyComponents and DecisionCache reject raw Bearer tokens, JWTs, and session cookies with ErrCodeTokenLeakDetected.
Private resources fail closed: unauthenticated requests to private resources strictly fail closed (allow=false, 403 Forbidden) and never cache an unauthorized allow.

Engine CLI flag -evaluate-cache and HTTP endpoints (/api/v1/policy/cache/evaluate, /api/v1/policy/cache/stats, /api/v1/policy/cache/invalidate) registered in cmd/policyhelix/main.go and proxied through Node supervisor (scripts/serve-web.mjs).
Ten Apache-2.0 synthetic fixtures cataloged with SHA-256 digests in tests/fixtures/policyhelix/C24/manifest.json.

Automated regression test coverage established in tests/cache_test.go covering manifest integrity, key binding, TTL expiry, revocation invalidation, bounded LRU eviction, race safety under -race, zero-token invariants, fail-closed semantics, CLI execution, and HTTP endpoints.
